diagnosis: ServiceMeshHealthDiagnosticView allows any authenticated user to probe internal microservice registry details by supplying arbitrary service_name values. The endpoint exposes internal RPC hostnames, Kubernetes namespaces, and gRPC port numbers without verifying that the requesting user belongs to the engineering operations team.
exploit_request:
GET /api/health/mesh/payment-processor-core/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasmesh.internal
Authorization: Token customer_user_token
Accept: application/json
